# Vietnam Accounting 30-Day Interactive Learning Web — Full Context Specification

> Comprehensive technical and statutory reference for the Vietnam Accounting 30-Day Learning Platform. Designed for LLM and autonomous agent ingestion.

## 1. Statutory & Regulatory Baseline (2026-2027)

- **Law on Accounting**: Law No. 88/2015/QH13.
- **Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC**: Issued 27/10/2025, effective 01/01/2026, replacing Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC. Renames Form B01-DN to "Báo cáo tình hình tài chính" (Statement of Financial Position), grants enterprise autonomy in opening Level 2/3 sub-accounts, standardizes functional currency translation to VND, and enforces internal control & digital voucher governance.
- **Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC**: Full 9-class Chart of Accounts (154 accounts) for general and large enterprises.
- **Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC**: Simplified SME Chart of Accounts (57 accounts). Explicitly prohibits 13 accounts: `621`, `622`, `623`, `627` (replaced by `154`), `641` (replaced by `6421`), `521` (direct debit to `511`), `413` (use `515`/`635` in operating phase), `157` (track on `156`/`152`/`155`), `212` (track on `211`), `213` (use `2113`), `113` (use `111`/`112`), `243`, and `347` (no deferred tax in SME regime).
- **Circular 58/2026/TT-BTC**: Micro-enterprise (doanh nghiệp siêu nhỏ) accounting regime, issued 25/05/2026, effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 132/2018/TT-BTC. Abolishes the double-entry Chart of Accounts: transactions are recorded directly in 11 simplified ledgers (S1-DNSN through S4d-DNSN) tailored to 4 tax payment methods; financial statements reduced to 2 forms (B01-DNSN Statement of Financial Position, B02-DNSN Business Results); family members of the legal representative may serve as the accountant; no Chief Accountant required. The platform exposes a minimal conversion dataset (TT 132/2018 identifiers) for balance migration.
- **VAT Law No. 48/2024/QH15**: Effective 01/07/2025 (Article 14 Clause 2 Point b), lowering the mandatory non-cash payment threshold from 20,000,000 VND to 5,000,000 VND (VAT inclusive) for input VAT creditability.
- **VAT Rate Reduction (Decree 174/2025/ND-CP)**: Issued under Resolution 204/2025/QH15, effective 01/07/2025 to 31/12/2026: reduces the 10% VAT rate by 2% to 8% for eligible goods and services. Excluded sectors keep 10%: telecommunications, financial activities (banking, securities, insurance), real estate business, metals and prefabricated metal products, mining products (except coal), and goods/services subject to Special Consumption Tax. **2027 rollover**: from 01/01/2027 the 8% rate expires and the standard 10% rate applies again (household businesses distributing/hand-making goods go from 0.8% back to 1%).
- **SME 30% CIT/PIT Reduction (Decree 398/2026/ND-CP)**: Effective 2026-10-29, applicable to tax years 2026 and 2027 (detailed by Resolution 43/2026/QH16): enterprises, household businesses and business individuals with ANNUAL REVENUE NOT EXCEEDING 10,000,000,000 VND receive a 30% reduction of the CIT/PIT payable amount (CIT computed on the post-incentive tax). Declare via Form 01/Form 02 of ND 398/2026; exceeding the 10B threshold forfeits the reduction and requires additional payment of the reduced tax via Form 03 of ND 398/2026.
- **Tax Payment Extension (Decree 245/2026/ND-CP)**: Effective 2026-06-27 to 2026-12-30: extends VAT & PIT filing deadlines for household businesses by up to 5 months (Q2 -> 02/11/2026, Q3 -> 30/12/2026); CIT provisional payments Q2 -> 02/11/2026 and Q3 -> 30/12/2026; 50% of land rent -> 02/11/2026. Businesses must submit a formal written extension request BEFORE 02/11/2026; all extensions expire 30/12/2026.
- **Household Business Revenue Threshold (Decree 141/2026/ND-CP amending Decree 68/2026/ND-CP)**: From tax year 2026, the household business revenue threshold is raised from 500,000,000 to 1,000,000,000 VND/year (below it: no percentage-based VAT/PIT on revenue; above it: mandatory tax code registration).
- **Household Business Filings (Circular 18/2026/TT-BTC)**: Effective 2026-03-05 (per Government Portal metadata; verify against the official PDF), replacing Circular 40/2021/TT-BTC, amended by Circular 50/2026/TT-BTC: new filing forms for household businesses.
- **Personal Income Tax (PIT)**: Resolution 110/2025/UBTVQH15 (issued 17/10/2025, effective 2026-01-01, applied to the WHOLE tax year 2026): family deductions raised to 15,500,000 VND per taxpayer (186,000,000 VND/year) and 6,200,000 VND per dependent — applicable from tax year 2026 onward, not mid-year. PIT Law No. 109/2025/QH15 and Decree 253/2026/ND-CP, together with Circular 87/2026/TT-BTC (effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 111/2013/TT-BTC), govern the procedures: dependent deduction registration (each dependent registered once only, deduction <= 3,000,000 VND/month per dependent); non-resident individual real-estate transfers taxed at 2% of the transfer price.
- **E-Commerce & Digital Platform Tax**: Decree 117/2025/ND-CP (effective 01/07/2025): e-commerce platforms withhold, declare, and remit VAT & PIT on behalf of household/individual businesses trading on their platforms via the dedicated e-commerce e-tax portal. Decree 68/2026/ND-CP amends Decree 117/2025 (amendment effective 01/07/2026); Decree 141/2026/ND-CP raises the household revenue threshold to 1B VND/year from tax year 2026.
- **Global Minimum Tax (Pillar Two)**: Decree 236/2025/ND-CP (effective 15/10/2025) guiding Resolution 107/2023/QH15: 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT) for multinational groups with consolidated revenue >= EUR 750 million, applicable from fiscal year 2024; Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC introduces sub-account `TK 82112` (supplementary CIT expense under the global minimum tax).
- **Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT)**: Circular 89/2026/TT-BTC (effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC) for cross-border digital, cloud, software, and advertising payments (NET two-step gross-up vs GROSS withholding). Revenue-based % rates are UNCHANGED from TT 103/2014 (distribution 1%/1%, services 5%/5%, construction with NM 3%/2%, production-transport 3%/2%, interest 5%/5%). New filings: monthly declaration 01/NTNN and annual finalization 02/NTNN.
- **E-Invoicing**: Decree 123/2020/ND-CP & Decree 70/2025/ND-CP expired 01/07/2026, replaced by Decree 254/2026/ND-CP; together with Circular 91/2026/TT-BTC (effective 01/07/2026, replacing Circular 32/2025/TT-BTC and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC) and Decision 1450/QD-TCT XML schema (34-hex MCCQT tax authority code). TT 91/2026 key changes: invoice template codes (mã mẫu hóa đơn) are digits 1-9 (1 = VAT invoice), invoices initialized from cash registers (máy tính tiền) for retail, and a 4-step correction process for erroneous invoices.
- **Chief Accountant Certificate (Circular 101/2026/TT-BTC)**: Effective 2027-01-01 (replacing Circular 199/2011/TT-BTC): chief accountants must hold the new certificate (152-hour update track or 180-hour full track); certificates are valid for 5 years. Training must be completed before 31/12/2026.
- **Accounting Practice**: Decree 174/2016/ND-CP remains in force regulating the accounting practice (licensing of accounting service firms and practicing certificates).

## 2. Core Mathematical & Accounting Invariants

1. **Double-Entry Balance Invariant**: $\sum \text{Debits} \equiv \sum \text{Credits}$ across all posted journal entries.
2. **Statement of Financial Position (B01-DN) Invariant**: Total Assets (`Mã 270 = Mã 100 + Mã 200`) $\equiv$ Total Resources (`Mã 440 = Mã 300 Liabilities + Mã 400 Equity`). Contra-asset accounts (`TK 214`, `TK 229`) and contra-equity (`TK 419`) are presented as negative deductions.
3. **Income Statement (B02-DN) Cascade**: `Mã 10 = Mã 01 - Mã 02`; `Mã 20 = Mã 10 - Mã 11`; `Mã 30 = Mã 20 + Mã 21 - Mã 22 - Mã 25 - Mã 26`; `Mã 40 = Mã 31 - Mã 32`; `Mã 50 = Mã 30 + Mã 40`; `Mã 60 = Mã 50 - Mã 51 - Mã 52`.
4. **Indirect Cash Flow Statement (B03-DN) Cross-Statement Invariant**: `Mã 50 = Mã 20 (Operating) + Mã 30 (Investing) + Mã 40 (Financing)`; Ending Cash `Mã 70 (B03-DN) = Mã 50 + Mã 60 + Mã 61` $\equiv$ `Mã 110 (B01-DN)`.
5. **Inventory & COGS Invariant (VAS 02)**: Strictly prohibits negative physical inventory (`quantity < 0`). Abnormal material/labor/overhead waste beyond normal capacity (VAS 02 Paragraph 11) is expensed immediately to `TK 632` rather than capitalized into `TK 154`/`155`.
6. **SME 30% Reduction Invariant (ND 398/2026)**: For revenue <= 10B VND in tax years 2026-2027: `Tax payable after reduction = 0.7 x Tax payable before reduction` (CIT computed on the post-incentive amount); revenue of exactly 10,000,000,000 VND still qualifies, 10,000,000,001 VND forfeits the reduction.

## 3. Pedagogical Architecture

- **10 Modules / 30 Days**: From Accounting Equation & Double-Entry Foundations (Module 1) to Capstone Closing & Financial Statements (Module 10).
- **Webb's Depth of Knowledge (DOK 1-3)**: 40% DOK 1 (Recall), 40% DOK 2 (Application), 20% DOK 3 (Strategic CFO/Chief Accountant Analysis).
- **Rule of One Diagnostic Engine**: Prioritizes learner errors across 4 cognitive tiers (Tier 1: Tax fraud/statutory violation -> Tier 2: Structural accounting imbalance -> Tier 3: Regime/account classification error -> Tier 4: Arithmetic error) and surfaces exactly one actionable next step to prevent cognitive overload.
- **3-Tier Socratic Hint Ladder**: Progressive anti-spoil hints (Tier 1: Domain scope -> Tier 2: Statutory equation -> Tier 3: Isomorphic twin example).
- **Where to add new concepts**: each day holds 3-5 concepts (tested invariant). New 2026 tax-update concepts (ND 398/2026 30% reduction; 2027 rollover traps) live in Day 30 of Module 10 (`c30-3`, `c30-5`). Prefer extending Day 30 up to the 5-concept cap before creating new days.
